copy.mask-diagonal-help: Exchange the two opening coordinates, with or without reversing their signs. Source order and gaps stay the same; the inspected spot stays put. Undo restores the whole mask.

diagonal.message: diagonal preserves unrelated state and answers its supplied native experiment

copy.mask-return-hole-help: Return the chosen opening to the same numbered opening in the kept mask. Other openings and the inspected spot stay put. A missing kept opening or a collision leaves it unavailable. Undo restores the whole edit.

returnhole.message: returnhole preserves unrelated state and answers its supplied native experiment
